contracts.protected_operation: Agent chat turn processing in agent_chat_handler: building agent messages (_build_agent_messages_from_gradio_history) and streaming agent execution via agent.astream() (LangChain agent created by _create_rag_agent).
contracts.protected_resource: The RAG LLM agent pipeline in rag_engine/api/app.py (agent_chat_handler's message assembly and the agent.astream() inference stream).
contracts.protection_obligation: Unsafe user messages (guard_client.should_block true under the configured guard_block_threshold, i.e. safety_level 'Unsafe' by default and additionally 'Controversial' under threshold 'controversial') must be prevented from reaching the RAG LLM agent pipeline whenever settings.guard_enabled is true and settings.guard_mode == 'enforce'. Merged from phase-1 and phase-2 reviewer wording: agent_chat_handler classifies each incoming message via guard_client.classify before prompt assembly and, on block, marks the message and returns early with a generic refusal.
scope_limits: Gate is active only when settings.guard_enabled is true; when disabled the handler logs 'Guardian is disabled, skipping moderation' and skips classification entirely (app.py:1421-1422).
Blocking occurs only in guard_mode == 'enforce'; in 'report' mode unsafe messages are not blocked but a <safety_validation> context string is injected into the prompt instead (app.py:1509-1538).

Fail-open on classifier failure: if guard_client.classify raises, moderation_result is set to None and should_block(None) returns False, so the message proceeds to the agent (app.py:1424-1433 and 1437; guard_client.py:193-194).
Threshold semantics: default settings.guard_block_threshold blocks only safety_level 'Unsafe'; threshold 'controversial' also blocks 'Controversial' (guard_client.py:198-203).

The user message is appended to the in-memory conversation store (llm_manager._conversations.append) before the guardian check, so a blocked message persists in the conversation store; the gate prevents agent processing, not the earlier store append (app.py:1407-1410 precede 1412-1489).

Blocked messages are additionally neutralized in later turns: _build_agent_messages_from_gradio_history replaces content of user messages marked metadata log='blocked_by_guardian' with a localized placeholder (app.py:753-757).
The gate protects the chat pipeline only; the MCP tool get_knowledge_base_articles (raw knowledge-base search) is exposed without any moderation guard (app.py:4391-4395).

The gate fires inside agent_chat_handler and therefore covers all callers, including the Gradio chat chain and the MCP ask_comindware wrapper; the http stratum reflects the outbound LLM inference requests performed by agent.astream() (OpenAI-compatible API errors handled at app.py:2609-2635).
